title: Episode
description: One published video: five dilemmas, their voiceover lines, and the metadata that ships with it. This file plus dna/video-dna.json is everything the render needs.

episode.description: Episode number. Appears in the badge and in the title — the numbered series is what makes viewers come back.

edition.description: Optional title tag, e.g. 'FOOD EDITION', 'HARD EDITION'. Measured to carry breakout videos at every channel size.

blocks.description: Exactly five, in ramp order: easy+funny, easy, medium, hard, hardest. The DNA's 8500ms block length assumes five.

reveal.description: How this block ends. Either real poll numbers, or an explicit prediction with no number. There is no third option.

vo.description: Two lines. Setup lands at 200ms, reaction at 4300ms once the numbers are on screen.

setup.description: Max 14 words. Poses the choice; never explains it.

reaction.description: Max 10 words. Names the surprise in the result. Never restates the dilemma.

cta.description: One line, one ask, pointing at the poll. Never 'like and subscribe'.

title.description: Pattern: 'Would You Rather... #N' plus the edition when there is one. The numbered series is the measured winner in this niche.

tags.description: From the measured tag cloud: would you rather, quiz, would you rather game, this or that, wyr, impossible choices.

pinned_comment.description: Carries the poll link and the question that converts viewers into commenters.

video_id.description: Filled after upload; used to pull retention in the measure stage.

dna_version.description: The video-dna.json version this episode was rendered against, so a style change can be correlated with a retention change.
